rc2-before-after-honest.title: Before/after counts honest — attribution of G2 vs #548
rc2-before-after-honest.imperative: Confirm the note does not overclaim G2's share. The 17 interleaved/NoneType recoveries are #548's; G2's specific contribution is Saudi DEV error->no_speed_stream. Note must make this honest.
rc2-before-after-honest.finding: RESOLVED in attempt-2. The corrected note now cleanly separates the two fixes in four places: (1) Headline (lines 18-23) states PR #548 recovered 17 of 18 and this issue's G2 fix recovered exactly 1 (Saudi Arabia DEV, the case #548 did not fix). (2) New 'Attribution: #548 vs this fix' section (lines 92-113) with a per-fix table: #548 -> 17 cases (14 interleaved-origin + 3 NoneType-origin) error->ok; G2 -> 1 case (Saudi DEV) error->no_speed_stream, plus 'this issue's actual code contribution to the headline is the 1 Saudi Arabia DEV case. The other 17 were already recovered by #548 on main before this run.' (3) Baseline note (lines 40-42) annotates that the OLD column predates BOTH fixes and the table reflects their combined effect. (4) Per-case interpretation (lines 73-75) reclassifies: 14 interleaved-origin + 3 NoneType-origin -> ok, with Saudi DEV the 15th interleaved-origin case #548 did NOT recover. The reclassification is honest and matches attempt-1 verification: Saudi DEV's old DB surface error reads 'interleaved n=0' but its root cause is an empty session-wide speed stream, so #548's fit_stint_hp guard (None->no_accel_samples for empty stints) does not produce an ok fit; G2's earlier empty-stream guard catches it as no_speed_stream. Internal arithmetic is consistent (14+3=17 ok; +1 no_speed_stream +1 no_laps = 19) and the tally check is present. No new misstatement introduced.

rc3-no-regression-framing.title: No-regression framing correct — param drift attributed to #548 not G2
rc3-no-regression-framing.imperative: Verify G2 diff touched NO successful-fit numeric/estimation path. Confirm param drift attribution is correct (to #548, not G2). Flag if note misattributes drift as G2 regression.
rc3-no-regression-framing.finding: G2 diff (git diff src/) confirmed: session_fit.py adds only (1) empty-stream early-return guard on a pre-computation path, (2) ValueError catch cleanup that adds no_speed_stream to the existing no_accel_samples catch, (3) 'windows or None' simplification (same semantics as 'windows if windows else None'). calibration.py adds only two len-check guards at the top of the if-windows: branch. fit_store.py changes only a comment. NONE of these touch any numeric computation, GP fitting, kernel evaluation, parameter estimation, or output value calculation. G2 cannot change physics params for any previously-ok fit. The note correctly attributes the 2-20% param drift to #548 commit 1c501ccf which changed calibrate_session_hp to use flying-lap windows (affecting the calibration window, thus smoother HPs, thus all physics params). The note explicitly says 'commit 1c501ccf (PR #548) changed calibrate_session_hp to use flying-lap windows' as the cause. No misattribution of drift as G2 regression. The note says 'The G2 fix is a correctness improvement' referring to the calibration change (which is #548, not G2) in wording that conflates the two — but the causal chain for drift is correctly identified as the calibration window change in 1c501ccf.
